title: IAEA Live Chart: 60Co half-life 1925.28 d (uncertainty from the seconds column)
summary: The Live Chart row for 60Co lists half-life 1925.28 with unit d. The seconds columns fix the absolute uncertainty at 0.14 days.
body: The IAEA Live Chart ground-state row for 60Co (Z=27, N=33), extracted 2026-11-18, lists half_life 1925.28, unit_hl d, unc_hl 14, half_life_sec 166344192, and unc_hls 12096. Dividing half_life_sec by half_life gives 86400 seconds per unit, so unit code d is days in this row. Dividing unc_hls by that same number gives an absolute uncertainty of 0.14 days. The small integer unc_hl (14) matches that absolute uncertainty as 14 in the last significant place of the printed half-life, not as 14 days on its own. The leading decay field is B- at 100 percent. The row's ENSDF publication cut-off field is 31-Dec-2012. This is the database row, not a new laboratory measurement made for this card.
